description: Shared vectors of Chrono (Ruby and JS), skeleton of W2-0: the cases below are certain; the track T4a adds the rest (including the mutants of a wrong answer) before it builds the functions. 'args' are strings as the schema holds them; 'result' is the canonical output.

duration.doc: Whole years from one year to the other, the year 0 not counted: -27 to 14 is 40.

century.doc: The Italian label of a year's century: 'II secolo a.C.'.

roman.doc: A positive integer below 4000 as a Roman numeral.

parse_roman.doc: A Roman numeral as an integer, nil when it is not one.

mutants.doc: The wrong values of duration that a typical error gives (year 0 counted, eras subtracted, same era added), by name.
